SELECT s.id, s.sku_id, ps.sku_code AS sku_code, ps.name AS sku_name, ps.product_id, p.name AS product_name, s.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, s.quantity, s.locked_qty, s.defective_qty, s.deleted, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM stock s LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON s.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND s.sku_id = #{skuId}
AND ps.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuCode}, '%')
AND ps.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuName}, '%')
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND s.quantity > 0 AND s.quantity <= 10
AND s.quantity = 0
AND s.quantity > 10
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
SELECT id, sku_id, warehouse_id, quantity, locked_qty, defective_qty, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM stock WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND deleted = 0
